profile.headline: Hands on Software Architecture Team Lead/Manager
profile.summary: Hands on experienced senior architect and developer with 25+ years diversified experience in designing and managing software solutions for financial institutions. Served as trusted adviser to CTO and Managing Directors of major financial institutions. Track record of successfully building financial trading systems for multiple international organizations.  Proven ability to design and develop stable, reliable, high-performing, secure system by leveraging architecture, design and development knowledge.

positions.title: Software Architecture Team Lead/Manager
positions.description:
Green field development of award winning, fixed income “PILOT” trading platform. Best performing, low latency, highly scalable, cloud deployable and easily extensible platform. Multi software layer platform development allowed for different business entities to extend and share business functions with ease.
Versatile business platform that supports multiple different business venues. Bond, Futures, Swaps, IRS, Equity, FX, and Commodities trading platform. Seamless integration of Big-Data used in real-time pricing and risk analysis.

Hands on Software Architecture Team Lead 
Serialization:  Pilot-Proto is highly customizable for fastest and smallest on-the-wire data representation. Built in multi-version, compression, filterable/routable based on SQL selector, cross-language, encryption to protected data at rest. 
Multi-Language:  Serialization support for C#, Python, JS, Java, Excel Plugin. Build micro-service in multiple languages and share business objects.
Extremely capable excel plugin to allow for discovery and subscription/publication of any entitled data onto pilot network. Full support of RPC from within excel.
Pluggable Messaging:  Qpid, RabbitMQ, Kafka, HornetQ, Custom Broker
Microservice Framework: Full lifecycle from design of data, data/service dependencies, cloud deployment and management, and monitoring. Customized Proxy (RPC) based communication. Highly efficient framework to provide dynamic discoveries of metadata, providers, and consumers
Proxy/RPC: Proxy over messaging, RPC over direct socket, RPC over rest, RPC over excel
Clustering: Zero config Leader selection based on service weight, multi-backup takeover. Dynamic cluster creation based on microservice criteria
Cloud Deployable:  Simplified deployment properties allowed for ease of container management. Admin console to control full lifecycle.
Federation: Distribution of Data, Security, Communications, Entitlement from each domain/company.  Licensing framework, Inter-domain entitlement

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Help build Order Management System for Fix Income trading platform.  Primarly involved in designing and developing Bond OMS.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Architect, design, and develop critical component of an IRS Real-Time Trading System for IRS and 
CDS Default Swaps based on Dodd-Frank Regulations. Offering both anonymous Limit Order Book and Request for Quote execution—to enable Javelin SEF provide optimal liquidity with transparency and market depth. All these messages supported FIXML5.0 SP2 with embedded FpML 4.6.

Messaging API -- Provide vendor neutral implementation of messaging API. API supported high level 
connection, session, publisher, subscriber concept.

Matching Engine – To satisfy very tight specification to process order under a millisecond by optimizing Limit Order Book (LOB). Optimize publishing of price events as market depth changes for each order event. Matching algorithm to provide full, partial, Fill or Kill (FOK), Dealer-to-Dealer Workup. Custom serialization to optimize multi-price /depth price change event (aggregated, full depth).

Trading API – Develop from ground up a fully functional trading API. With future RFQ expansion, API was highly extensible in providing new functionality without impacting existing clients. Custom message and serialization was developed to provide high level of backward compatibility. It was fully integrated with ION platform to provide seamless SEF integration for existing ION clients.

PTS API – As one of extension to the SEF’s API, it provided clients to query for order/trades in multiple formats. SQL compatible format with temporal condition to provide ultimate flexibility to request historical and real-time query. FixML 4.0 support was provided to enhance client’s uniform experience to streamline development effort with existing system.

RFQ API – Architect and Design a framework to provide API. API was designed with market maker auto quoting in mind. It provided high level of threading to support multiple requests for multiple products concurrently.

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.description:
Lead architect in designing ultra fast core framework to deliver highly reliable trading platform.  Pioneer™ has been developed from grounds up to be next generation strategic trading solution for BOFA Securities. I was instrumental in designing core components such as Messaging, Query & Subscribe, Subject Management, and Process Deployment/Management.  System was designed to be highly scalable to support high volume pricing and trading from multiple regions Pioneer™ has been in production for more than 8 years, supporting trading of bonds and futures, as well as, internal analytic pricing engines.

Pioneer™ Messaging API offers a messaging abstraction layer in Java. This API enables applications to use multiple messaging implementations (e.g., EMPIRE, RV, MQ,JMS) to create, send and read messages from PIONEER Communication Network (PCN), which has proven to be a powerful abstraction layer above a specific vendor’s implementation.  Powerful concept of Virtual Circuit (VC) to represent a virtual connection between a client and server using messaging bus.  VC as a central component in implementing Clustering API.  Clustering API provided Pioneer with invaluable tool to make the system’s availability to achieve 99% or higher.  This is only possible clustering framework is used to provide high level of fault tolerant, load balanced, seamless failover to one of hot or passive service.

Pioneer™ Subject Management Framework provides an abstraction layer for the creation and manipulation of subjects required by clients or servers to communicate business events.  Framework allows for Service to register business objects and contract on how clients to communicate.  This allowed all Pioneer service to be loosely coupled.

Designed and implemented Pioneer™ custom service framework to allow creation, configuration, management and deployment of service that is HA compliant with active and passive clusters.  Framework supported clustering, load-balanced, caching and persistence.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer in implementing award wining Bond, Futures, Futures Options and Equity trading platform.  PRIMETrade™ is a multi-tiered application consisting of a Swing-based client, propriety asynchronous middleware (Ambrosia); backend processes (gateways) and database access is 100% java.

Architected, designed and implemented an offering gateway supporting cross products (Gov, EuroGov, EMG, MBS, ABS, CMBS).  Gateway provided reference data caching, matching of offering subscription from internal system (ETCore).  Supported and managed criteria and instrument based portfolio based on the product reference data and available offering.  Build custom criteria based filtering to support creation and maintenance of multi-asset portfolios.  Supported client to perform google type quick search based on maturity, coupon, isin, cusip based filters.  

Designed and implemented JNI solution for communication between C++ and PRIMETrade™ gateways.   

Designed and implemented program trading API.  Supported multiple language platforms (Java, C++, and COM).

Helped CM in developing multiple scripts to automate deployment process.

positions.title: Lead System Architect
positions.description:
Responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying intranet-based Securities Lending System (SLS) which supports the Bank's Euroclear Autolend program. Primary functionality included automatic loan allocation, allocation adjustments, Monthly fee reports, client and management reports, and reference data update. 


SLS is implemented as a 3-tier application using Java as frontend, C++/CORBA as middleware, and Oracle as backend. Tools.h++ and DBTools.h++ were also used to build the multi-threaded CORBA server. I was responsible for developing a major part of the frontend using Swing and JDK2. As sell as all of the backend components of the system.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught C++, C, Computer Concepts, Windows 95.

positions.title: Application Consultant
positions.description: Involved in detail analysis of the customer requirements, design and implementation of these requirements using C++, CORBA(Orbix).  As a principal developer, implemented core engines, which perform matching, and lookup for DBConnect project that involved object distribution through CORBA.  Used JAVA to create front end Client Application.  Portion of it was developed using Java Workshop GUI builder.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for development of a Service Provisioning System utilizing C++, Oracle, Teleuse and Motif. Specifically created the base class structures and designed the class libraries to be implemented for this system. The graphical user interface used by the work management and tracking team was built and implemented with Teleuse to create a Motif based front end. 

Additional responsibilities involved StarLan Network Administration for the three servers (Starserver S & E, NCR 3410).  Installed and configured HUBS (Starlan 10 Smart Hubs, Cabletron Hubs). Performed hardware installation/maintenance of StarLan and 3-COM ethernet cards Maintained, updated and installed new software for 27 users (Windows 3.1, WFW, TCP/IP 32, Pathways, LAN Manager).  Performed system administration for UNIX SVR4.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the analysis, design and development of an Automated Weather Distribution System utilizing X, Motif, C, SCCS, IPC on a Sparc 20. Ported to Sparc-20 using X11, Motif, Sun XGL. Used Builder Xcessory to create User Interface.  IPC to receive and route graphical products to distributed system.  Internet Communication using Berkeley SOCKETS.  Created CM environment using SCCS for multiple users.
For the Trident Factory Automation System utilized C, C++ and PC.  Top level Design, Coding, and Development of OCR System. Color vision Software on MATROX board. Designed Character Recognition Software on COGNEX.  Ported user interface to Windows 3.1 using Visual C++.  Worked to MIL 2167A spec.

patents.description: Filed patent in China for a QNS framework build for Pilot Platform.
